name: rotator_cc
description: rotator_cc with phase increment 2 pi 0.0123 vs the NCO rotator

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: rotator_cc advances its phase by multiplying with a complex64 increment, so its phase drifts linearly (see ddc_rotator: about 1 LSB after 4000 samples); the float instance uses the exact phase word.

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Phase truncated to 10 table bits: error power (2 pi / 2^10)^2 / 3 -> 49.0 dB; worst sample |x| * 2 pi / 2^10 = 132.7 LSB for |x| <= 0.66, plus requantisation.
Phase rounded to 10 table bits: 55.0 dB; |x| * pi / 2^10 = 66.4 LSB plus requantisation.
Phase truncated to 12 table bits: 61.1 dB; |x| * 2 pi / 2^12 = 33.2 LSB plus requantisation.
Phase rounded to 12 table bits: 67.1 dB; |x| * pi / 2^12 = 16.6 LSB plus requantisation.
